query: Papi's Restaurant On Wheels (Soul Food) Catering
name: Papi's Restaurant On Wheels (Soul Food) Catering
address: 1263 S Military Trl Ste 3, West Palm Beach, FL 33415, United States

reviewSamples.author: Cuban Love
reviewSamples.text: This spot in amazing the food is on point! BABY... them collard greens mac & cheese and ribs was bussing!!! They just got a customer for life. I want to say thank you for the amazing service and food! It's worth the half hour drive. Everyone loves the food, listen go try they food you will fall in love.

reviewSamples.author: Matthew Colon
reviewSamples.text: Tasty tasty tasty ribs! I even got the crunchy meaty tips!!! Yummy! The sides are on point from tangy to sweet! Papi's is ready for your order, for sure! My son approved so we are going back!!

reviewSamples.author: Shauniece Tipton
reviewSamples.text: The Food here is AMAZING !!! I literally could not wait until I got home to devour my plate, my favorite dish is the Rib dinner and the delicious southern baked beans, and let's not get started on the sauces.

reviewSamples.author: Henry
reviewSamples.text: I can only say....bring a friend or family member. They answer the question what would Jesus do? ANSWER: Go to Papi's Soul Food & BBQ. BTW....hurry, they HUNGRY out here.

reviewSamples.author: Erica Coluzzi
reviewSamples.text: Hands down best soul food and hard working owner!! I wish I could learn a recipe or two! Y'all come show love and support!!! Food def hits the spot.
